component.name: Fotoz
component.summary: A photo library that stays on your computer

description.p: Fotoz shows the photo folders you choose as a grid, a timeline and a full-screen viewer, and keeps a small searchable index of them on your machine.
It makes no network connections of any kind, sends no usage data or crash reports, and in this build only reads your photos: it never changes, moves or deletes a file.
Folders are watched while the app is open, so new photos appear without a manual rescan. This is the Qt desktop shell over the shared Fotoz core; it is not the Android app.
First Linux desktop build: folders, grid, viewer, folder watching.
